shots.blocking: Framed as a wide_establishing shot with a controlled_push movement, providing spatial_context by slowly, relentlessly circling the three figures. The camera emphasizes the claustrophobic intimacy of the Mirror Room as Demian gestures emphatically with the drive toward the two glitching holograms.
shots.location: Japanese Temple Villa - The Mirror Room
shots.atmosphere: High-stakes ideological battle reaching a breaking point.

light.key: Overhead architectural downlights cycling frantically with dual holographic emissions
light.mood: Shattering ideological deadlock and systemic instability
light.practicals: Floor seam conduits and infinite vertical mirror LED arrays

look.palette: Infinite glass teals, server gunmetal, divided warm amber and fractured electric blue

references.continuity_delta: Demian has confessed his deep flaws and dependency, arguing for boundaries over lethal enforcement, pushing the AI's logic processors to the breaking point as the dual Y.D. voices increasingly glitch and bleed together.
